entries.reason: native disclosure of the device identity options: the library has no disclosure component, and <details>/<summary> give the toggle, keyboard and aria-expanded for free
one-line live status with a dot and a countdown: Banner is a block and Chip forces an icon on danger, so no library component fits. The dot is aria-hidden and the text carries the state
hidden file picker for identity import: the library has no file-input component. It is sr-only and triggered by a library Button; no text is typed into it
